github_actions.events: Existing push, pull request, issue, release, repository, schedule, and manual dispatch triggers
github_actions.aion_watch: One finite KoblluxLoop cycle per workflow run, before Rhea appends the GitHub event
github_actions.recursion_guard: Existing [skip ci] guard remains on generated memory commits
github_actions.event_tags: Rhea derives canonical archetypes, frequencies/opcodes, component labels, and cycle metadata from event and changed paths

integrations.n8n_export: kobllux_n8n_bridge.py exports all 16 canonical archetypes and operation phases; legacy opcode/frequency values are retained only as legacy_* metadata
integrations.n8n_memory_ingest: n8n/workflows/KOBLLUX_MEMORY_INGEST.json validates and stores archetypes/tags idempotently; inactive until an operator configures and activates it
integrations.github_to_n8n: Existing authenticated memory proxy forwards GitHub event metadata only when server-side Actions secrets are configured
integrations.scanner: Scanner reports add canonical profiles/tags per path while retaining the legacy filename-heuristic assignment and opcode separately
integrations.local_loop: Loop memory records include all 16 archetype tags and canonical cycle/fractal metadata

limitations: No infinite process or persistent filesystem daemon is started
Actions sees committed repository events; uncommitted local file edits are not watched
The Codex watcher invoked by Actions remains one-shot
No n8n instance was contacted or activated; the root workflow.json is a separate legacy sample
No secrets or credentials were read, created, or copied
